name: foray
description: Root manifest. Convenience test script only — deliberately NO dependencies and NO build step; the site is served static from this directory (see CLAUDE.md). Note the absence of "type": "module": app.js and search-engine.js are classic browser scripts and must stay CommonJS-interpreted for the tools/ scripts that require() them. ES-module semantics are scoped to player/package.json.
//test: Runs exactly what CI's data-and-site job runs, by discovery — see tools/ci/run-suites.mjs. It used to name player/ and test/ by glob, which meant `npm test` at the root silently covered 6 of 25 suites and was the last hardcoded suite list in the repo (issue #140).
